service.description: The warranty claims of the user's organizations (WarrantyFind, WarrantyList), newest first: each with its customer, product, serial, order, coverage end and basis, the current decision and its approver, the linked repairs or return, the next action, the assignee and the state (Needs evidence, Assessment, Approved repair or replacement, Rejected, Customer follow-up, Closed), read, not stored. By customer, product, serial number, order, agreement, state, assignee and claim date; with queueIds, only the claims of those queues and those assigned to visibleAssigneePartyId (an app's own case scope). Requires SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT, SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE or WARRANTY_APPROVE (PERMISSION_DENIED).

One claim for WarrantyAssessment: the case (customer, organization, assignee, claim date, status), its evidence (product, quantity, fault, serial and its owner and status, order, invoice, agreement, prior claims on the serial), its revision and state, the coverage as get#WarrantyCoverage reads it, its decisions (current or not), its repairs with their tasks and its returns, and what the user may do (save, decide, approve, link a repair, with the reason when not). A case of another type is answered with isClaim false, so its evidence can be recorded. Requires SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT, SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE or WARRANTY_APPROVE; refuses a missing case and another organization's alike (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Make a claim, or record its evidence (WarrantyEvidence). With no requestId a new RqtWarranty case is made through SupportCaseServices.create#Case (the organization, customer, subject and the case's other fields, its queue, template and assignment rules); with one, the case becomes a claim when it is of another type. The evidence: the product (a RequestItem, with the quantity and the fault), the serial or lot by assetId or serialNumber (an asset of the case's organization, by its facility's owner or the vendor of the sale it was issued on, and of its customer, by its owner or that sale's customer; ASSET_UNAVAILABLE), the order (a sale of the organization to the customer, from the serial's sale when not given; ORDER_UNAVAILABLE), the invoice (from the order line's billing when not given; INVOICE_UNAVAILABLE) and the agreement (a service agreement with the customer; AGREEMENT_UNAVAILABLE), each a RequestRecord link. A change counts the claim's revision once and supersedes its decisions. Refuses a serial of another product (ASSET_PRODUCT_MISMATCH), a closed or merged case (CASE_CLOSED, CASE_MERGED), a claim revision not the current one (STALE_REVISION naming it) and a quantity not above zero (QUANTITY_INVALID). Requires SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and a case of the user's organizations. The same operation key answers the first result.

The coverage lookup, writing nothing: for a claim (requestId) at its date, or a serial (assetId), lot or product of a customer of one of the user's organizations at a date (now when not given). The agreement first (a service agreement, AgrService, of the organization with the customer, active and in effect, with a warranty term, TtWarranty, for the product), then the product's warranty at sale (the serial or lot traced through AssetIssuance to its sales order, customer and ship date; the term from the product's PftWarranty feature, its number and time unit; the coverage end the ship date plus the term), else none (WcbNone: only goodwill covers it). Answers the basis, whether it is covered, the terms and their source, the coverage start and end with the end's source, the sale's order, line, shipment and ship date, and each step in the trace. Requires SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT, SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE or WARRANTY_APPROVE; refuses another organization's claim or serial (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, ASSET_UNAVAILABLE) and a customer it does not serve (CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE).

Record the entitlement result at the claim's revision (WarrantyDecision): covered, partly covered, rejected or goodwill, with the terms (the lookup's when not given) and their source, the coverage basis and end, the reason (required but for covered), the next due date and, for a chargeable repair (partly covered or rejected), the charge estimate in its currency (the organization's when not given) and the customer's consent. A manual coverage end (overrideCoverageEndDate) needs its reason (OVERRIDE_REASON_REQUIRED). Covering a claim the lookup found expired (a rejection override, through a coverage end set with its reason) and goodwill need WARRANTY_APPROVE, whose holder is recorded as the approver; covering a claim not covered is refused (NOT_COVERED). The decision supersedes the claim's earlier ones; the case is not resolved. Requires SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT, the claim's revision (REVISION_REQUIRED; STALE_REVISION naming the current one) and its product or serial (EVIDENCE_REQUIRED). Refuses an unknown decision (DECISION_INVALID), a charge on a covered or goodwill decision (CHARGE_NOT_ALLOWED) or below zero (CHARGE_INVALID), and a closed or merged case. The same operation key answers the first result.

Link a repair to the claim (RepairLinks, F67): a new AssetMaintenance on the claim's serial (mantle.product.EquipmentServices.create#AssetMaintenance, AsMntCreated, MntTpWarranty) with its WepMaintenance task (taskWorkEffortId: the required work, the facility, the due date and the assignee, who works for the organization), or an open AssetMaintenance of that serial; linked to the case by RequestRecord. The asset is checked here, as create#AssetMaintenance checks nothing (F51): of the case's organization and its customer (ASSET_UNAVAILABLE); customer-owned equipment keeps its owner. Needs a current decision (NOT_DECIDED) that covers the claim, or a chargeable repair (NOT_APPROVED) whose customer consent is recorded (CONSENT_REQUIRED), and the serial (ASSET_REQUIRED: a replacement goes through a return). Refuses no required work (WORK_REQUIRED), an assignee who does not work for the organization (ASSIGNEE_UNAVAILABLE), another serial's or a closed maintenance (MAINTENANCE_UNAVAILABLE) and a closed or merged case. Requires SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT. The same operation key answers the first result.

Move a repair of the claim: in process, completed (with its result in the comments) or cancelled (before it started), through the AssetMaintenance status flow, its task following (In progress, Complete, Cancelled). Its completion tells the claim's agent (the WarrantyWorkFinished rule) and leaves the case as it is. Refuses a maintenance the claim does not link (MAINTENANCE_UNAVAILABLE) and a move its status does not allow (STATUS_INVALID). Requires SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT and a claim of the user's organizations.

A customer's service agreement (AgrService, F50, F101), the coverage lookup's first source: made (Active from its date unless another status is given) or changed, between one of the user's organizations and a customer it serves, with its dates, description and its warranty term (TtWarranty): the terms' text, and the product it covers as an agreement item (none: every product). P4's service level condition reads the same agreement. Requires SUPPORT_POLICY_EDIT. Refuses another organization (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a customer not served (CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE), another's agreement (AGREEMENT_UNAVAILABLE), no terms (TERMS_REQUIRED), an end before the start (DATES_INVALID) and an unknown status (STATUS_INVALID).

The serials and lots the user's organizations delivered to a customer (crosscut §3.2 DeliveredItems, read over AssetIssuance and the orders' parts), newest first, up to 200: each with its product, serial or lot, order, shipment and ship date, the coverage end and its source and whether it is covered now (get#WarrantyCoverage), and an open claim on it. Requires SUPPORT_CASE_EDIT, SUPPORT_CASE_MANAGE or WARRANTY_APPROVE.
